g.title: conflict
g.text: Legacy identity or different analyzer name

g.title: attempt
g.text: Register active manual row as Claimed
At most two charged transient failures

g.title: save
g.text: report_details: canonical JSON + digest + full-delivery state
Scheduled → Reporting; manual → eligible idle handoff

g.title: post
g.text: Full report; unsupported route → compact fallback

g.title: retry
g.text: Durable replay / full promotion every 60 s

g.title: note
g.text: Scheduled concurrency 1 is not a global runner limit
Manual requests may overlap scheduler and each other
Manual handoff preserves running / archived identities
Done settlement ≠ completed outcome ≠ full delivery
